survivorAssessments.assessment: Equivalent redundant absence guard: undefined selected also fails the following non-null selected-file identity check.
Equivalent optional access: undefined/null have already short-circuited before the selected file property is read.
Equivalent internal file-mode sentinel: neither file nor empty string selects hunk/declaration mode in supported consumers.
Equivalent optional access: private refresh callers supply a position object from the supported capture adapters, including the empty default object.
Equivalent mode-only change with null entity: non-null entities imply declaration mode; null-entity declaration/file modes render and navigate identically.
Equivalent under the entity/mode invariant: non-null entities imply declaration mode; null entity changes only the internal non-hunk sentinel.
Equivalent under public navigation: entity selection always establishes declaration mode before loading.
Equivalent short-circuit access: the preceding error-code string test succeeds only for a non-null error object.
Equivalent returned-visit refresh: exact-pair labels/query are immutable, and departure or another traversal saves the displayed viewport before its next use.
Equivalent optional access: a prior shown visit implies an existing cursor entry; discarded markers clear shown before this branch.
Equivalent duplicate synchronous history notification: load finally emits completed state in the same turn; intermediate callback counts are not a contract.
Equivalent unobserved diagnostic: only obsolete requests throw this error, and obsolete errors are suppressed by the outer request check.
Equivalent zero-offset clamp: the added branch is reachable only for total=offset=0, computes offset=0 and performs no additional query.
Equivalent zero-offset boundary: total=offset=0 is the only newly admitted branch and it leaves state and requests unchanged.
Equivalent optional access: refreshSelection has already constructed its positions object before this branch.
Equivalent internal file-mode sentinel after lost declaration: entity and hunk are cleared; later explicit actions establish their own modes.
Equivalent duplicate synchronous intent check: every awaited read/error path checks intent and there is no intervening await before publication.
Equivalent defensive postcondition under supported notifications: active-token changes invalidate intent, and navigation cannot load a known retired pair.
Equivalent optional access after intent validation: active-null status invalidates the request before the active token can be inspected.
Equivalent unobserved defensive diagnostic: supported token changes invalidate the request before this mismatch branch can be reached.
Equivalent retired-visit viewport save: replacement permanently retires lookup; history rejects that token before its positions can be reused.
Equivalent optional access: loading a valid view requires an active status; active-null delivery clears loading before this branch.
Equivalent optional access: a displayed/loading view requires a prior latest status; foreign initial markers are tested independently.
Equivalent optional access: a valid retained visit can exist only after an active status establishes latest.

limits: Full controller and reader scope plus survivor follow-ups. Cohorts overlap and their counts must not be added. Equivalent survivors remain raw survivors and are not credited as caught. Timeouts are separate from failing-test catches. CSS, app glue and benchmark harnesses are outside this scope.
